_layout_notes: Two sheets: 'Pvt car mapping' (State Code | State Name | Status: preferred/Non Preferred/declined — Pvt Car only) and 'Grid' (State | Segment | COA%).

The kshema engine's preprocessWorkbook reads the mapping sheet; the Grid parse emits GCV/PCV rows per explicit state and fans the two Pvt Car rows (Preferred 0.43 / Non-Preferred 0.38) across states by status, with declined states as no-payout.
